note: Three images: a cover and one per section opener. The closing page deliberately has none. The corpus reuses the cover field without the photograph for a closing, and a fourth image would be the point at which a discipline becomes a mood board. Subjects are physical and single because the direction token asks for that; none of them depicts data, because photography in the sampled corpus carries data on none of the 16 pages it appears on. Masters come back as multi-megabyte PNGs and are kept in art/original, gitignored; the committed asset is JPEG. A photograph is not a PNG, and 13MB of them has no business on a page.

items.subject: A wide shallow metal tray holding dried beans spread unevenly across it, heaped thickly toward one end and thinning to a scatter at the other, shot from directly above
items.alt: Dried beans spread unevenly across a shallow tray, heaped at one end and thinning to a scatter at the other.

items.subject: A single steel measuring tape uncoiled in one long unbroken run across an empty seamless surface, running out of the frame at both ends
items.alt: A steel measuring tape uncoiled in one long run across an empty surface, leaving the frame at both ends.

items.subject: A single pair of open steel calipers lying flat on an empty seamless surface, jaws spread wide, shot from directly above
items.alt: A pair of steel calipers lying open on an empty surface with their jaws spread wide.
items.note: The first render of this id was six cylinders descending cleanly in height, which is a picture of a monotonic decline. The section it opens finds that the medians do NOT decline in order, so the image argued against its own page. Calipers measure a spread and imply no ordering.
